FLAGGED_AUTHOR.title: Why this post needs review: the author is flagged
FLAGGED_AUTHOR.body: This post has not been found to break any rule. It waits for an admin because its author has live strikes: every post by a flagged account, scheduled ones included, needs review before publishing (BR-64). Read the content below and decide for this version only.

COMPLIANCE.title: Why this post needs review: a policy violation was detected
COMPLIANCE.body: The automated content check flagged this post. Compare the cited part with the post to confirm or dismiss the warning.

COPYRIGHT.title: Why this post needs review: possible copyright infringement
COPYRIGHT.body: The automated copyright check flagged this post. Compare the evidence with the text and images to confirm or dismiss the warning.

moderation.noLiveStrikes: The author has no live strikes; you can allow publishing if the content is fine.
moderation.strikeRule: 3 yellow strikes convert into 1 orange. A live orange flags the account; 3 orange or 1 red opens a suspension review.
moderation.approveHint: This version continues on its workflow and schedule. A note of at least 10 characters is required.
moderation.blockHintChoice: This version is not published, the author gets a strike and can edit and resubmit.

users.createHint: The account starts as Email unverified with no strikes. The user must open the activation email to verify it and set their own password before using BrandHub.

users.requestedPlanHint: Recorded as a request only; paid access starts after payment.
users.activationNote: The activation email is mandatory: a single-use link valid for 72 hours verifies the email and sets the password.

users.auditNote: Every role or profile change is written to the audit log.
users.pendingActivation: This account is waiting for email activation.
users.resent: Activation email resent; the previous link no longer works.
